```{r setup-mascot_mood, include = FALSE, echo = FALSE}
studio_character <- if (exists("studio_character")) studio_character else formals(mascot::mascot)$character
```

```{r mascot_mood-try-live, echo = FALSE}
if (!in_studio()) guide_try_live("mascot_mood")
```

### The `r nrow(mascot::mascot_moods())` moods

```{r mascot_mood-table, echo = FALSE}
guide_table(mascot::mascot_moods())
```

<div class="pg-callout">

<strong>The mood never speaks alone.</strong>
The status line under the mascot shows the character's line for the mood (or displays your custom text),
providing clear meaning for screen readers and anyone who cannot distinguish facial expressions.

```{r mascot_mood-controls, echo = FALSE}
if (in_studio()) htmltools::tags$p("Try moods with the Mood drop-down in the top bar.")
```

</div>

```{r mascot_mood-mistakes, echo = FALSE}
if (!in_studio()) guide_mistakes_html("mascot_mood", studio_character)
```
